profile.headline: Principal iOS Developer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary: Experienced iOS Native Application Developer with a demonstrated history of developing and deploying native Swift apps built around SwiftUI

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and led development of major experiences across the Fidelity Health app and supporting GraphQL experience layer. Established SwiftUI best practices across multiple teams. Drove adoption of the latest Swift and SwiftUI features including Swift 6 strict concurrency.
Held regular hands-on Swift and SwiftUI deep-dive sessions to explore interesting technical topics.
Developed a mock server in Vapor used extensively for UI Regression testing complex features and serving test data that is otherwise impossible to configure in a test environment.
Developed two key Rust CLI utilities used for local API development across a dozen teams, along with associated CI infrastructure. Mentored newcomers to Rust and created a small Rust community.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Developed and deployed an app with SwiftUI and Combine to manage and aggregate live data from local instances of Pi-hole™ DNS blockers through the RESTful JSON API. The app currently has over 100 active paid users. This app can be found on the App Store by following the link above.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Led development from the ground up of an iOS app utilizing MVVM and SwiftUI for scanning material safety labels from the field using the device’s camera. Built a REST backend in server-side Swift (Vapor) to deliver JSON data associated with scanned labels. Modernized two legacy UIKit apps deployed to over 350 internal employees for logging environmental incidents and scheduling compliance tasks. Refactored older MVC codebase to use modern Swift 5, SwiftUI, and MVVM while reducing reliance on external dependencies. Collaborated in peer review of iOS applications across the enterprise. Developed key components of the enterprise iOS CI pipeline. Architected and implemented an asynchronous reactive backend application in Kotlin for real time aggregation and analysis of air emissions data delivered in XML from over 80 power plants. This application reduced the server resource usage by nearly two orders of magnitude compared to its predecessor.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: (During Duke Energy COVID contractor furlough) Short-term part-time contract to help rapidly integrate key features into Anica’s existing patient portal app. Added support for pairing and communication with Bluetooth health devices, adding data to the user’s HealthKit store, and processing data that the user chose to share with the healthcare provider.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description: Led development from the ground up of a fitness app intended to replace the limited functionality of the existing Apple Health app. Developed a powerful custom charting API and integrated this with HealthKit to display a user’s aggregated health data generated by other 3rd party fitness apps.

positions.title: Mobile and Online Banking Consultant
positions.description: Led planning and execution of mobile and online banking Red Team exercises for top 40 banks. Developed novel approaches to bypass mobile banking defenses, and presented discoveries to bank executives. Developed drop-in features for clients such as advanced jailbreak detection and certificate pinning. Reverse engineered production banking apps with Hopper Disassembler and used Charles Proxy to intercept, modify, and inject network traffic between the mobile app and bank API. Worked with client developers to debug and resolve vulnerabilities discovered in the mobile authentication channel.

positions.title: Lead iOS Developer
positions.description: Developed a fitness app with Objective-C to intelligently generate semi-randomized workouts within parameters specified by a personal fitness expert. Generated workouts were tailored to the user’s selected fitness goals, and users could view videos of a professional trainer performing each exercise.

positions.title: Hash Creator
positions.description: Published an Objective-C app to the App Store to generate, crack, and identify a variety of cryptographic hash functions on the device using brute force and wordlist attacks.

educations.schoolName: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

projects.title: Buoyant
projects.description: Buoyant is an open source UI library in Rust, intended for no_std embedded applications. The layout and animation system faithfully replicates core SwiftUI behavior and presents a SwiftUI-like API.
